asr.full_text: What if I told you a boring software company found a glitch in the financial system to keep buying bitcoin and on a massive risk today that company holds billions in bitcoin and that's more than three percent of all bitcoin that will ever exist and quietly becoming more powerful than most banks and here's the truth nobody tells you this entire strategy is built on leverage, so is this the greatest trade in history? Or is ticking time gone? Back in 2020 ,CEO Mike Saylor looked at his company's 500 million dollars in cash and realized it was melting due inflation, he called it a melting ice cube. Most CEOs buys back their own stocks or pay dividends. Saylor, did the unthinkable he traded the ice for digital gold, he went all in. but he didn't stop at his own cash here's where the strategy gets serious saler realized he could borrow billions of dollars from wall street at extremely low rates and uses that money to buy even more bitcoin here's how it works he issues convertible depths he uses that borrowed cash to buy more bitcoin as bitcoin goes up the value of the company goes up that pushes the stock higher and gives him access to even more capital the result he's using other people's money to accumulate bitcoin but here's the part most people miss why would investors give them that money in the first place? because in return they get paid through preferred shares and structured products. Some of these Investors are earning around 10 & more than 11% just to fund this Bitcoin purchases. So now you see that you have investors earning earning income while the company uses that money to keep buying Bitcoin. They're not buying occasionally. They're buying constantly and at scale. And you can see it in the news these buys are reported almost every week. Strategy is continuing its Bitcoin buying spree, acquiring two point one billion dollars worth of the cryptocurrency last week. This as the company's shares have fallen by nearly 60 percent in the last year. In 2026 alone, they've already bought tens of thousands of Bitcoin. That includes a single purchase of more than $1.5 billion and they are still buying. So why not just buy Bitcoin directly. simple Leverage When bitcoin goes up 10% MSTR can move much more. Its bitcoin on steroid But there is a massive catch. If you hold bitcoin you just hold the asset. No deadlines no debts. No creditors. You can hold it for 100 years if you want Michael strategy is different it holds obligations it has creditors and it has doubts maturing in 2027 2028 2029 so what's happening if Bitcoin crashes a lot of critics scream Martin call but that's not really the main issue here sailor didn't structure this like a normal short-term loan most of it it's long-term corporate debt the bigger risk is delusion if things go wrong the company may need to issue more shares to raise cash and when that happens your piece of the pie gets smaller that's the trade-off bitcoin gives you the asset microstrategy gives you amplified exposure to the assets but with extra layer of risk and that's why this is bigger than just one company. Sayller isn't just betting on bitcoins he's betting against the US dollar and on a future where the rarest asset wins microstrategy is no longer just a software company it became something else entirely a bitcoin vault built on financial engineering and the craziest part other companies are now copying this exact playbook now i want to hear from you do you think this is the smartest Bitcoin strategy ever created or just a system that works until it doesn't I'm lamia thanks for watching and if you enjoyed this don't forget to like and subscribe follow me on x and join our telegram community thanks for watching and I'll and that you'd leave us a comment down below and maybe give us a thumbs up.
